en.topic_title: Alleged UK spy for Hong Kong died by suicide ahead of trial, British jury rules
en.topic_summary:
A former British marine who was charged with spying for Hong Kong has died by suicide, a UK jury has found. Matthew Trickett took his own life after a public services firm failed to locate him and fit his electronic tag.



Matthew Trickett, one of the three men arrested by London police on suspicion of spying for Hong Kong. Photo: Royal Marines.
